title: EXTERNAL REPORTING I
description: Examines the theory and practice of financial accounting, the processing and controls phases of the accounting system, and reporting to external parties. Emphasis is placed on the accounting cycle and financial statement structure and content. The emphasis on the accounting cycle includes the processing and tracing of transaction data from source documents to financial statements.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (BA 211, 211H, 211Z or 211HZ) and (BA 213, 213H, 213Z or 213HZ).
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 211, BA 211H, BA 211Z, BA 211HZ, BA 213, BA 213H, BA 213Z and BA 213HZ.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Finance (182)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Accounting (A016)
  • Accounting (A017)
  • Accounting (C191)

Enrollment limited to students in the Oregon State - Corvallis campus.
clssnotes:
ACTG 317 must be completed on declared campus.
